core.title: Pentagon Polished Chrome Corner Wire Basket, Deltana WBP542

text.description_html:
Deltana WBP542, Solid Brass Pentagon Wire Corner Basket

The polished chrome finish of the Pentagon Wire Basket gives it a modern feel. Deltana's WBP542 Basket features an easy installation. It is perfect to utilize corner space not only in the bathroom as a shampoo shelf, but also in the kitchen, the bedroom, the garage, or just about any room where you need some extra storage space. It is made out of solid brass with the attention to high quality that is expected from Deltana.

Shop more of the Deltana Wire Baskets

Features and Specifications of the WBP542 Solid Brass Corner Basket:

  • Material: Solid Brass
  • Finish: Polished Chrome
  • Length: 5"
  • Width: 5"
  • Depth: 1-1/4"
  • Deltana WBP542 Pentagon Corner Wire Basket Specifications (PDF)

Sold Individually. Package includes: 1 basket, mounting screw cover, and all necessary mounting screws.
